svg.title: Actual prepared public fixtures
svg.desc: Actual NASA image pixels, PhysioNet MLII samples at 360 Hz, independently calculated 40 Hz FIR and Fourier references, and first shipped MNIST instance of each class. This is an input illustration, not an invented runtime measurement.
